output.brief: The rejects come from Arnholt resin being dried in Press 5's dryer (D5), which has been degraded since July. Neither factor alone causes the problem. Arnholt on Press 5 rejects about 10%, whether run on first or second shift, by new or experienced operators. Quillan on Press 5 rejects 0.9%, and Arnholt on Press 7 (dryer D7, healthy) rejects 0.8%. Arnholt resin arrives wetter, and D5 can't dry it. The same Arnholt lot dried in a good portable dryer gave 0.8% rejects, versus 10.4% through D5. The operators are not the cause; the second shift looks worse only because all its VX runs on Press 5. Don't discipline them, and don't drop Arnholt. Do this week: repair D5 (heater and desiccant), restore the original alarm limit, and keep Arnholt off D5 until its dew point is verified at −40 °C. Add a feed-throat moisture check for each lot. Also ask Arnholt why its incoming moisture is higher. Hold off on moving the octabins and renting space: every Arnholt sample came from the annex, so storage versus supplier is untested. Confidence is high on the main cause and moderate on the storage question.
